### ObjectID
ObjectID represents a Git object identifier.


| Field | Type | Label | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| id | [string](https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/proto3#scalar) |  | <p>id is the 40 character hexadecimal hash value that identifies an object. (required)</p> |
